subject: CloudLeaf renewal — invoice closure and VAT reconciliation
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@cloudleaf.com>

Cc: accounts-payable@cloudleaf.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 14:15:00 -0500
Subject: CloudLeaf renewal — final invoice & VAT details

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick onboarding last quarter. We're ready to close out the current term and reconcile the usage true-up before the renewal starts. A couple of items from finance: 

- We show an overage/true-up for Q4 of approximately €18,400 (usage tokens). Please confirm the final billed amount and currency.
- CloudLeaf is an EU business (IT VAT ID: IT12345678901). We need a single consolidated invoice that supports the reverse-charge VAT treatment if applicable. Please confirm the invoice will show net amounts and our VAT ID on record.
- Our PO number for this renewal is CL-2027-PO1 — please include it on the final invoice.
- For payment, AP prefers SEPA transfer. Can you provide bank details and a remit-ready PDF?

We also need the signed SOW (DocuSign) copy for our procurement team before we process payment. Can you route the DocuSign directly to accounts-payable@cloudleaf.com?

Appreciate a timeline — we’d like to process payment before month end.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Head of Operations 
CloudLeaf SRL
sofia@cloudleaf.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@cloudleaf.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: CloudLeaf renewal — final invoice & VAT details

Hi Sofia — thanks, and congrats again on the launch. Quick confirmation and next steps below.

1) Final billed amount: our system shows a pro forma true-up of €18,372.55 (EUR). We will issue a single consolidated final invoice dated 2027-01-31 that includes the subscription proration plus the usage true-up line.

2) VAT treatment: we can apply reverse charge (net invoice) if CloudLeaf is EU VAT-registered. Please confirm the VAT ID you provided (IT12345678901) is the billing entity and we will run VAT validation. If validated, the invoice will be net with a note: "VAT reverse charge — Article 196 EU VAT Directive."

3) PO & payment: we will include PO CL-2027-PO1 on the invoice. Bank details (SEPA) and remit instructions will be included in the remit-ready PDF. Payment terms: Net 30 by default — let us know if you need Net 15 for this closure.

4) DocuSign: I will re-route the signed SOW copy to accounts-payable and attach a link to the executed DocuSign.

Attached: Draft invoice (pro forma) and a DocuSign link. Final invoice will be generated once VAT is validated and the PO is confirmed.

Next steps: please confirm the VAT ID and whether AP wants Net 30. Once confirmed, I will task finance to issue the final PDF (CloudLeaf_Final_Invoice_20270131.pdf) and send the DocuSign copy to accounts-payable.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
